evidence.title: Definium Therapeutics Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 Voyage Study of DT120 ODT in Generalized Anxiety Disorder
A Phase 3 Trial of DT120 for Generalized Anxiety Disorder (Voyage) - NCT06741228 (Definium Therapeutics US; primary completion 2026-07-15; no results posted; last update posted 2026-09-02)
Definium Therapeutics Announces Positive Topline Results from Phase 3 Voyage Study of DT120 ODT in Generalized Anxiety Disorder (Business Wire release, republished)
Definium Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Highlights (Voyage enrollment complete; topline anticipated week of August 10, 2026; no result disclosed)

outcomes.note: Criterion: first public report of the Voyage (NCT06741228) primary endpoint result, either direction. Definium's press release of 2026-08-12 (07:00 ET) reports the primary endpoint: HAM-A total score change at week 12, LS mean -11.6 (DT120 ODT 100 ug) vs -6.2 (placebo), difference -5.4, p<0.0001, d=0.81; the result is positive. The 2026-08-06 Q2 release gave only timing guidance ('Voyage results anticipated week of August 10'), so nothing earlier disclosed the result. ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06741228 (Definium Therapeutics US, Phase 3, GAD, primary completion 2026-07-15) shows no results posted as of its 2026-09-02 update, and no peer-reviewed publication precedes the release. Emerge (MDD, 2026-06-22) and Panorama (GAD, results announced for 2026-09-14) are different trials and do not count. Date = 2026-08-12.

outcomes.note: Criterion: first approval letter in Drugs@FDA for a product whose active ingredient is psilocybin, lysergide or midomafetamine, any indication, any sponsor. Checked 2026-09-13: Drugs@FDA searches for 'psilocybin', 'midomafetamine' and 'lysergide' each return 'Your Drugs@FDA Search Did Not Return Any Results'; the openFDA Drugs@FDA API (data of 2026-09-11) returns 'No matches found' for all three; FDA Novel Drug Approvals 2026 (current 2026-09-11) and the Drugs@FDA September 2026 approvals report list no such product. Candidates: Compass COMP360 psilocybin is a rolling NDA, final modules expected Q4 2026 (8-K, 2026-08-05); Resilient (ex-Lykos) resubmitted its midomafetamine NDA in August 2026, under review; Usona has not filed; Definium DT120 is pre-NDA. Vouchers, breakthrough designations, the 2024 CRL and the 2026-09-14 hearing are not approvals. Not occurred as of 2026-09-13.
